definitions.WIFE: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.
definitions.AUNT: The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.
definitions.SISTER: A daughter of the same parents as another person; a female sibling.
definitions.BABY: A very young human, particularly from birth to a couple of years old or until walking is fully mastered.
definitions.NIECE: A daughter of one’s sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either the daughter of one's brother ("fraternal niece"), or of one's sister ("sororal niece").
definitions.COUSIN: The child of a person's uncle or aunt.
definitions.UNCLE: The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.
definitions.MOTHER: A (human) female who has given birth to a baby.
definitions.FATHER: A (generally human) male who begets a child.
definitions.BROTHER: Son of the same parents as another person.
definitions.CHILD: A person who has not yet reached adulthood, whether natural (puberty), cultural (initiation), or legal (majority).
definitions.KIN: Persons of the same race or family.
definitions.FOLKS: A grouping of smaller peoples or tribes as a nation.
definitions.TWIN: Either of two people (or, less commonly, animals) who shared the same uterus at the same time.
definitions.ELDER: An older person or an older member, usually a leader, of some community.
definitions.GIRL: A female child, adolescent, or a young woman.
definitions.NEPHEW: A son of one's sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law.
definitions.HEIR: Someone who inherits, or is designated to inherit, the property of another.
definitions.FAMILY: A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption).
definitions.PARENT: One of the two persons from whom one is immediately biologically descended.
definitions.SPOUSE: A person in a marriage or marital relationship.
definitions.ADULT: A fully grown human or animal.
definitions.YOUTH: The quality or state of being young.
definitions.INFANT: A very young human being, from birth to somewhere between six months and two years of age, needing almost constant care and/or attention.
definitions.NEIGHBOR: A person living on adjacent or nearby land.
definitions.FRIEND: A person other than a family member, spouse or lover whose company one enjoys and towards whom one feels affection.
definitions.GUEST: A recipient of hospitality, specifically someone staying by invitation at the house of another.
definitions.HOST: One which receives or entertains a guest, socially, commercially, or officially.
definitions.BRIDE: A woman in the context of her own wedding; one who is going to marry or has just been married.
definitions.GROOM: A man who is about to marry.
definitions.WIDOW: A woman whose spouse has died (and who has not remarried); feminine of widower.
definitions.SIBLING: A person who shares a parent; one's brother or sister who one shares a parent with.
definitions.POPPY: Any plant of the genus Papaver or the family Papaveraceae, with crumpled, often red, petals and a milky juice having narcotic properties.
definitions.MUMMY: An embalmed human or animal corpse wrapped in linen bandages for burial, especially as practised by the ancient Egyptians and some Native American tribes.
definitions.ANCESTOR: One from whom a person is descended, whether on the father's or mother's side, at any distance of time; a progenitor; a forefather.
definitions.LINEAGE: Descent in a line from a common progenitor; progeny; descending line of offspring or ascending line of parentage.
definitions.DESCENDANT: One who is the progeny of a specified person, at any distance of time or through any number of generations.
definitions.RELATIVE: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
definitions.CLAN: A group of people all descended from a common ancestor, in fact or belief.
definitions.TRIBE: A socially, ethnically, or politically cohesive group of people.
definitions.HOUSEHOLD: Collectively, all the persons who live in a given house; a family including attendants, servants etc.; a domestic or family establishment.
definitions.GENEALOGY: The descent of a person, family, or group from an ancestor or ancestors; lineage or pedigree.
definitions.MATRIARCH: A female leader of a family, a tribe or an ethnic or religious group.
definitions.PATRIARCH: The highest form of bishop, in the ancient world having authority over other bishops in the province but now generally as an honorary title; in Roman Catholicism, considered a bishop second only to the Pope in rank.
definitions.STEPBROTHER: The son of one's stepparent who is not the son of either of one's biological parents.
definitions.STEPSISTER: The daughter of one's stepparent who is not the daughter of either of one's parents.
definitions.GUARDIAN: Someone who guards, watches over, or protects.
definitions.NURTURE: The act of nourishing or nursing; tender care.
definitions.CHERISH: To treat with affection, care, and tenderness; to nurture or protect with care.
definitions.BOND: Evidence of a long-term debt, by which the bond issuer (the borrower) is obliged to pay interest when due, and repay the principal at maturity, as specified on the face of the bond certificate.
definitions.TRUST: Confidence in or reliance on some person or quality.
definitions.LEGACY: Money or property bequeathed to someone in a will.
definitions.GENERATION: The fact of creating something, or bringing something into being; production, creation.
definitions.ROOTS: The part of a plant, generally underground, that anchors and supports the plant body, absorbs and stores water and nutrients, and in some plants is able to perform vegetative reproduction.
definitions.HERITAGE: An inheritance; property that may be inherited.
definitions.TRADITION: A part of culture that is passed from person to person or generation to generation, possibly differing in detail from family to family, such as the way to celebrate holidays.
definitions.MEMORY: The ability of the brain to record information or impressions with the facility of recalling them later at will.
definitions.REUNION: The process or act of reuniting.
definitions.GATHERING: A meeting or get-together; a party or social function.
definitions.DINNER: A midday meal (in a context in which the evening meal is called supper or tea).
definitions.HOLIDAY: A day on which a festival, religious event, or national celebration is traditionally observed.
definitions.BIRTHDAY: The anniversary of the day on which someone is born.
definitions.WEDDING: To perform the marriage ceremony for; to join in matrimony.
definitions.ANNIVERSARY: A day that is an exact number of years (to the day) since a given significant event occurred.
definitions.CELEBRATION: The formal performance of a solemn rite, such as Christian sacrament.
definitions.GODCHILD: A child whose baptism is sponsored by a godparent.
definitions.GODFATHER: A man present at the christening of a baby who promises to help raise the child in a Christian manner; a male godparent who sponsors the baptism of a child.
definitions.GODMOTHER: A woman present at the christening of a baby who promises to help raise the child in a Christian manner; a female godparent who sponsors the baptism of a child.
definitions.STEPCHILD: The child of one's spouse but not one's own.
definitions.ADOPTED: To take by choice into relationship (a child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.).
definitions.TWINS: Either of two people (or, less commonly, animals) who shared the same uterus at the same time; one who was born at the same birth as a sibling.
definitions.PROGENY: Offspring or descendants considered as a group.
definitions.KINDRED: (often plurale tantum) Distant and close relatives, collectively.
